# React browser verification

## Verify React changes in a real browser

Inspect component boundaries, state transitions, semantic HTML, keyboard behavior, focus handling, loading and error states, and responsive layout. Run repository-native tests and build checks, then exercise the changed route in a browser at representative viewport sizes. Check the browser console and failed network requests. Do not accept a snapshot or successful build as proof that the interaction works. Record the route, viewport, interaction, and observable result used as evidence.
